content:
Just to be clear, you don't have a "Thunderbird account." Thunderbird is a program that you can use to manage accounts at external email providers such as Gmail, Yahoo, AOL, Comcast, etc.

So. assuming your email is with those or the like, all you need is an Internet connection. It shouldn't matter to Thunderbird or the email provider how you get there, just that you can get there.

Consider that I have a Gmail account, and I have Thunderbird installed on my laptop. I can travel anywhere where I can connect to the Internet, be it a hotel, airport, library, etc. and I can send and receive my email without changing anything.

content:
If all you want to backup is Local Folders, the easiest way (assuming you use Windows) is this:

  1. click help>troubleshootinginformation
  2. scroll to 'profile folder' and click 'open folder'
  3. exit thunderbird
  4. you are now in the profile. Click the Mail folder and you will then see the Local Folders folder
  5. highlight and copy to external media

The filters are in the file msgfilterrules.dat and that is in Local Folders
